## 

The Alchemy of Finance: Reading the Mind of the Market
Soros, manager of the billion dollar Quantum Fund, certainly has credentials that merit attention to his personal approach to money management. As might be expected, he describes his so-called "theory of reflexivity" in a manner more appealing to serious market players than to the casual investor.

## 

The Alchemy of Finance: Reading the Mind of the Market
Reveals a revolutionary approach to investing and how financial markets work and tests this theory by providing a day-to-day journal of portfolio management. Book recommendations, author interviews, editors' picks, and more. Read it now.
